qa.question: Why is HTTP 206 Partial Content preferred over 200 OK when delivering video lessons?

replies.text: Great question Rahul! With 206 Partial Content and the Range header, the browser only downloads the bytes needed for current playback. When a student seeks to 10 minutes in, the server immediately pipes that specific byte slice without downloading all preceding megabytes. This drastically reduces server memory and bandwidth.
